title: Plush Age
description: Adds cute pillows and comfy decorative items. Simple and vanilla-friendly!
body:
# Plush Age 

![visual](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4be343c899809840ace2a4cd46de222c21551030.jpeg)

## About this pack
This datapack was created for those who love cozy decor and small details. It is highly recommended for builders!


<details>
<summary>README</summary>

### Placing a pillow:

To place a pillow, simply throw (drop) the pillow item onto an **Armor Stand**. It will automatically snap into place and display properly.

### Removing a pillow:

To pick the pillow back up, just **left-click (punch)** it. 
*(Tip: If you're having trouble hitting it for the first time, press **F3 + B** to enable hitboxes. This will help you see exactly where to click!)*


</details>

### Note on Visual Updates:
The textures and models of the pillows may be updated and improved in future releases. We highly recommend joining our Discord server to share your feedback and help us shape the look of the pack!

### Note:
If you find any bugs, please report them in the **"#🪲report-bugs"** channel on our Discord server using the **"Plush Age"** tag!
